• **Audit** all centre assignments this week to identify coaches at risk of disengagement or absence; flag any centres relying on a single coach without a backup plan.

• **Schedule** weekly check-ins with centre managers during the first month of any new coach placement to catch satisfaction issues early.

• **Develop** a rapid replacement protocol so centres have a named backup coach available within 48 hours if their primary coach leaves or underperforms.
